en.headline: Zhipu plans HK$39.3 billion share placing and convertible bonds
en.dek: The Hong Kong-listed AI firm said a discounted H-share placing and zero-coupon convertible bonds would raise about HK$39.3 billion net.
body: Zhipu (stock code 02513), also reported in English as Z.AI, said it would raise a combined net amount of about HK$39.27 billion through a placing of new H shares and an issue of US dollar-settled zero-coupon convertible bonds.

According to the company’s announcement, as reported by RTHK and Hong Kong 01, it will place up to 21.965 million new H shares at HK$714 each, a 9.96 per cent discount to last Friday’s close of HK$793. The placing is expected to raise about HK$15.66 billion net and represents about 4.5 per cent of the enlarged share capital.

The bonds have a principal amount of 20.14 billion yuan, mature in 2027 and carry an initial conversion price of HK$892.50 a share, about 12.55 per cent above Friday’s close. Net proceeds from the bonds are expected to be about US$3.011 billion, or about HK$23.61 billion.

Zhipu said about 60 per cent of the combined net proceeds would go to research on the next-generation GLM foundation model and a fully self-training system, as well as computing capacity and related infrastructure; about 15 per cent to business expansion, strategic investment and possible acquisitions; and about 25 per cent to capital structure, working capital and general corporate uses. The company said its January initial public offering proceeds had been fully used by the end of August, and that about 34.92 per cent of a July placing had already been spent.

zh.headline: 智譜配股兼發可換股債 合共集資約393億元
zh.dek: 港股上市人工智能公司智譜公布，折讓配售新H股及發行零息可換股債券，預期合共淨籌約392.7億港元。
body: 智譜（股份代號02513）公布，將同步配售新H股及發行以美元結算的零息可換股債券，預期合共淨籌約392.7億港元。
公司公告及香港電台、香港01報道指，智譜將按每股714港元配售最多2,196.5萬股新H股，較上周五收市價793港元折讓9.96%，預期淨籌約156.64億港元，相當於擴大後已發行股份約4.5%。
債券本金總額為人民幣201.4億元，2027年到期，初始換股價每股892.5港元，較上周五收市價溢價約12.55%。債券預期淨籌約30.11億美元，折合約236.1億港元。
智譜表示，合共所得款項淨額約60%將用於下一代GLM基礎模型及完全自訓練體系的研發，以及大規模訓練、推理算力及相關基礎設施；約15%用於業務拓展、戰略投資及潛在併購；約25%用於優化資本結構、營運資金及其他一般企業用途。公司指今年1月上市所得款項至8月底已悉數動用，7月首次配售所得則已動用約34.92%。
